title: AgentPlan
description: Director-authored plan for a bounded embedded-agent task. The plan is schema-bound and reviewed before any tool call executes. Multi-stage production and generation tasks require an explicit user approval gate before tools run.

goal.description: Outcome-first statement. The plan fails if the goal cannot be met within the resource budget.

format.description: Delivery format (preset, aspect, caption style, ...). Mirrors the ProductionRunSpec.

evidence_queries.description: Bounded queries the planner intends to run. The session refuses queries outside this list.

proposed_tools.description: Tool registry references. Each entry's schema_hash must match the running capability registry.

expected_actions.description: Schematic summaries of actions the plan will submit; each maps to a registered action verb.

review_points.description: Stages where the user must approve before the next stage runs.

requires_user_approval.description: True for multi-stage production and generation. False only for reversible corrective edits already covered by the current review policy.
